x: After a mile, however, Harwood, of Surrey A.C., who had just returned from abroad after a spell in the Army, had a lead of about 40 yards with Weatherill, of S.L.H., and myself next.

Harwood and Matthews of Guildford made it quite clear at the start that they had no intention of relinquishing their unbeaten record, especially on their home course, but Hampshire and Cocks had other ideas.
